```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse=TRUE, comment="#>")
library(nlrFlow)
```

```{r}
s1 <- nl_simulate("gompertz",1:25,c(Asym=18,k=.44,xmid=3.7),sigma=.5,seed=1)
s2 <- nl_simulate("mitscherlich",c(0,30,60,90,120,180),c(Asym=8,delta=5,k=.025),sigma=.25,seed=2)
s3 <- nl_simulate("rectangular_hyperbola",c(0,100,300,600,1000),c(Amax=30,alpha=.07,Rd=1.2),sigma=.6,seed=3)
head(s1); head(s2); head(s3)
```
